containers.name: fair-value
containers.notes: Next.js release copied from the node's active slot and run as node server.js, uid 1001 (deploy). Database credentials stay in /etc/fair-value/<slot>.env and are not baked in. Lean rebuild 2026-10-27: one COPY --chown layer and no .next/cache, 502 MB -> 370 MB. Rolled out by digest through deploy-digest.yml.

containers.name: fair-value-mcp
containers.notes: uvicorn serving mcp_server.asgi:app on 8011, reached by the /mcp* and /v1/* split rule. Base image python:3.11-slim, so python lives at /usr/local/bin/python3.11 — which is the shebang the console scripts carry — and there is no /usr/bin/python at all. Checked inside the running container on 2026-11-20, which is how the previous note's '/usr/bin/python3.12 symlink' claim was shown to describe a build that never existed. TCP health: GET /mcp answers 405 by design.
